question: Which materials are named as suitable origins for ritual vessels?
premises: Clay is named as a material.
Bell metal and copper-metal origins are named.
inference: Ritual vessels may be made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell metal, or copper-metal.
uncertainties: The exact meaning of kūrmajaṃ in this ritual context is uncertain.
plain_english: O goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell metal, or born of copper and metal.
